messages.subject: Re: displaying multiple linear relationships in one graph or facet
parts:
It'd be easier to figure it out if you had an example, but if you simply want to facet with multiple groups you could use linetype or line color to separate the groups within another factor (facets). 

ggplot(data, aes(x, y, color=groupingvar1)+
geom_point()+
stat_smooth()+
facet_wrap(.~groupingvar2)

http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/stat_smooth.html
